purpose: Teach: エスカレート/傷つき/溺れ/出来上がる/先立っ/かぶせ/さかのぼっ/しゃべら

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、口論がエスカレートしすぎだぞ
lines.en: Riku, you escalate arguments way too fast.
lines.style: Sharp, direct call-out. Quick pace, no softening. Exasperated but affectionate — the tone of someone who's said this before. Slight head-tilt of 'come on.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、後輩を傷つき言葉で言うなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't use hurtful words on the juniors, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter than her jab. Steady, firm. Not defensive — genuinely correcting. Meets her eyes. The voice of someone who believes what he's saying.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、プールで溺れそうになったな
lines.en: You almost drowned in the pool, Riku.
lines.style: Dry, almost amused. Light delivery. Not mocking — more like 'remember that time?' Eyebrow raise in the voice. Testing whether he remembers.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、工作が出来上がるまで頑張ったな、桜
lines.en: You really committed to finishing that craft project, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine warmth under the surface. Slightly softer than his previous line. Acknowledging her effort without making a big show of it. A small, real compliment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、テストに先立って予習しろよ
lines.en: Study before the test, Riku. Don't wait.
lines.style: Practical, not nagging. Advice-mode — quick and matter-of-fact. The tone of someone looking out for him. No edge, just straightforward care.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宿題に答えをかぶせて隠してたな、桜
lines.en: You were hiding the answers under your homework, Sakura.
lines.style: Amused call-out. Dry, caught-you tone. Not angry. Light pace, like he's remembering something she thought she got away with. Gentle wry.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、歴史をさかのぼって調べる宿題やったろ
lines.en: You actually did that history research project, didn't you?
lines.style: Curious, almost surprised. Open tone — genuinely noticing something good. Not quite a question, more like 'I see what you did there.' Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、授業中にしゃべらないでくれよ、桜
lines.en: Don't talk during class, Sakura. Please.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Tired note underneath — not angry, just asking. Close, low volume. The voice of someone sitting next to her, not lecturing from a distance.
